# BhumiShop - Bhumisparsha School Virtual Store

## About
BhumiShop is the official virtual store of Bhumisparsha School, offering unique handcrafted products including books, art, t-shirts, mugs, bags, and accessories. Each product carries meaning, art and purpose, supporting the educational mission of Bhumisparsha School.

## Site Information
- **Name:** BhumiShop
- **Description:** Virtual store of Bhumisparsha School. Products with meaning, art and purpose.
- **URL:** https://bhumisparshaschool.org/shop
- **Primary Language:** Portuguese (Brazil) - pt-BR
- **Available Languages:** English (en), Portuguese (pt-BR), Chinese (zh), Japanese (ja), Spanish (es), Thai (th), Nepali (ne), Hindi (hi)
- **Framework:** Vue.js 3 SPA with Vite
- **Backend:** Supabase
- **Payment Providers:** AbacatePay (PIX, Credit Card), Pix Bricks International, Uma Penca, Mercado Pago

## Site Structure

### Public Pages
| Route | Name | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `/` | Home | Landing page with hero section, categories showcase, featured products, and circular gallery |
| `/produtos` | Products | Full product catalog with category filtering, search, and pagination |
| `/produtos/:id` | Product Detail | Individual product page with gallery, variants (sizes), add to cart functionality |
| `/carrinho` | Cart | Shopping cart with item management and checkout initiation |

### Authenticated Pages
| Route | Name | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `/login` | Login/Auth | User authentication with email/password, WeChat, Google, and SMS login |
| `/checkout` | Checkout | Multi-step checkout: Cart Summary, Contact Info, Shipping & Payment, Confirmation |
| `/minhas-compras` | My Orders | Order history with status tracking (pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled) |
| `/perfil` | Profile | User profile management and account settings |

### Admin
| Route | Name | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `/admin` | Admin Panel | Product and category management (requires admin role) |

### System Pages
| Route | Name | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `/:pathMatch(.*)*` | 404 Not Found | Catch-all route for unknown URLs |

## Features

### Shopping Experience
- Product catalog with categories (T-shirts, Accessories, Art, Mugs, Bags)
- Product variants with sizes (S, M, L, XL)
- Shopping cart with drawer UI
- Multi-step checkout process
- Multiple payment methods: PIX (instant), Credit Card, International payments
- Shipping calculation with free shipping threshold
- Order tracking and history

### International Payments
- **AbacatePay:** National Brazilian payment processing (PIX, Credit Card)
- **Pix Bricks International:** International PIX, UPI (India), Alipay, WeChat Pay
- **Uma Penca:** External checkout for branded merchandise (t-shirts, mugs)
- **Mercado Pago:** Latin American payment gateway

### User Authentication
- Email/Password authentication via Supabase
- Social login: WeChat, Google
- SMS-based authentication
- Role-based access (user, admin)

### Internationalization
Full i18n support with 8 languages:
- English (en)
- Portuguese/Brazil (pt-BR) - Default
- Chinese (zh)
- Japanese (ja)
- Spanish (es)
- Thai (th)
- Nepali (ne)
- Hindi (hi)

### UI/UX Features
- Dark/Light theme toggle
- Responsive design (mobile, tablet, desktop)
- Animated hero section with GridScan WebGL effect
- Scroll Velocity text animations
- Circular Gallery for featured products
- GSAP-powered scroll animations
- Skeleton loading states
- Toast notifications

## Product Categories
- Camisetas (T-shirts)
- Acessorios (Accessories)
- Arte (Art)
- Canecas (Mugs)
- Bags

## Key Entities

### Product
```
{
  id: string
  name: string
  description: string
  price: number (BRL)
  category: string (category ID)
  image: string (base64 or URL)
  stock_type: 'on_demand' | 'in_stock'
  sizes: string[] (e.g., ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL'])
  artist: string
  additional_info: string
}
```

### Order
```
{
  id: string
  order_number: string
  status: 'pending' | 'processing' | 'shipped' | 'delivered' | 'cancelled'
  payment_status: 'pending' | 'paid' | 'failed' | 'refunded'
  payment_method: 'pix' | 'card'
  total: number
  items: OrderItem[]
  shipping_address: Address
  created_at: datetime
}
```

### User
```
{
  id: string (Supabase UUID)
  full_name: string
  email: string
  phone: string
  role: 'user' | 'admin'
}
```

## API Integration
- **Supabase:** Database, Authentication, Real-time subscriptions
- **AbacatePay:** Payment processing API
- **ViaCEP:** Brazilian CEP (postal code) lookup
- **Mercado Pago:** Payment gateway
- **Uma Penca:** External merchandise store

## Contact
- **Email:** contact@bhumisparshaschool.org
- **Organization:** Bhumisparsha School
- **Copyright:** All rights reserved

## Technical Stack
- **Frontend:** Vue 3 (Composition API)
- **Routing:** Vue Router 5 (Hash History mode)
- **State Management:** Pinia
- **i18n:** vue-i18n v11
- **Styling:** CSS Custom Properties, Scoped CSS
- **Animations:** GSAP, Motion-V
- **3D Effects:** Three.js, OGL, Postprocessing
- **Build Tool:** Vite 7
- **Testing:** Vitest, Vue Test Utils
- **Hosting:** GitHub Pages (static)
